definitions.gloss: number of nights; length of stay in nights
definitions.explanation: The count of nights spent at a hotel, inn, or other accommodation. Used when discussing travel plans, booking details, or accommodation arrangements.

examples.japanese: {泊数|はくすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please select the number of nights.

examples.japanese: {泊数|はくすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{上|あ}がります→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The price goes up as the number of nights increases.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{泊数|はくすう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}する→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{空室|くうしつ}→空室：14798_kuushitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦されます→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When you enter the number of nights and number of guests on the booking site, available rooms are displayed.

notes:
A compound of {泊|はく} (overnight stay; counter for nights) and ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number, count). Frequently encountered on hotel booking websites, travel brochures, and reservation forms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {泊数|はくすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to change the number of nights
- {泊数|はくすう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じて→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧: according to the number of nights
- ⟦{最低|さいてい}→最低：01412_saitei⟧{泊数|はくすう}: minimum number of nights
- ⟦{連泊|れんぱく}→連泊：07049_renpaku⟧{泊数|はくすう}: consecutive nights stayed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {宿泊日数|しゅくはくにっすう}: number of accommodation days — a more formal synonym using ⟦{日数|にっすう}→日数：12953_nissuu⟧ (number of days)
- ⟦{滞在期間|たいざいきかん}→滞在期間：20474_taizaikikan⟧: length of stay — broader term covering the entire stay, not just nights
